code_connect.policy: Do not connect temporary mock components. Add Code Connect only in the review that promotes a stable API and includes the implementation reference.

components.usage: Use for an explicit action with visible text and a bounded loading/disabled state.
components.do_not_use: Do not use for navigation-only links, decorative labels, or controls that bypass server truth.
components.accessibility: Minimum 48dp/48px interactive height; state feedback is visible; focus indicator remains present.

components.usage: Use when the action is represented by an approved icon and has an explicit accessible label.
components.do_not_use: Do not rely on an illustration, color, or tooltip alone to name the action.
components.accessibility: Requires a non-empty accessible label, selected state semantics when applicable, and a minimum 48dp/48px target.

components.usage: Use for user-entered text with a visible label and supporting or error feedback.
components.do_not_use: Do not hide required instructions in placeholder text or use an unlabelled input.
components.accessibility: Label and message are programmatically associated; error state exposes invalid semantics and readable text.

components.usage: Use for query entry; preserve an accessible label and a deterministic empty/no-result state.
components.do_not_use: Do not make a decorative search pill the only path to a search action.
components.accessibility: Uses search input semantics, visible or programmatic label, keyboard/touch focus, and readable no-result feedback.

components.usage: Use for a short filter or selection value with visible text.
components.do_not_use: Do not use color alone to convey selected, unavailable, or error state.
components.accessibility: Selected and disabled states have programmatic semantics and visible text/shape distinction.

components.usage: Use to group related content; add interaction semantics only when the surface is actionable.
components.do_not_use: Do not use a card to disguise a modal, transaction state, or paid disclosure.
components.accessibility: Interactive cards expose a name and focus behavior; status is not conveyed by color alone.

components.usage: Use for short visible status/classification text such as Sponsored, SOS, or completed.
components.do_not_use: Do not use as the only accessible announcement or to imply an authoritative fact not in the response.
components.accessibility: Visible text accompanies semantic tone; sponsored/emergency meaning is not color-only.

components.usage: Use for a page-level title with optional navigation and actions.
components.do_not_use: Do not create a service-specific mini-brand header or hide the current page context.
components.accessibility: Title, navigation, and actions are named; focus order follows the page hierarchy.

components.usage: Use for top-level customer destinations with stable labels and selected state.
components.do_not_use: Do not add a remote destination or allow a service tile to bypass the compiled navigation registry.
components.accessibility: Each item has a label, selected semantics, and a keyboard/touch target that remains usable at scale.

components.usage: Use for an interruptive decision or focused secondary task with a deterministic dismiss path.
components.do_not_use: Do not use to imitate a system dialog or place payment/order truth in remote campaign content.
components.accessibility: Named dialog semantics, modal state, focus containment/return, and a reachable dismiss action are required.

components.usage: Use for organic merchant discovery with server-provided commerce facts.
components.do_not_use: Do not let merchant creative write rating, ETA, price, fee, availability, or sponsored state.
components.accessibility: Merchant identity, status, factual fields, media alternative, and interactive favorite action are named and readable.

components.usage: Use only when the server marks the placement sponsored and the slot is eligible.
components.do_not_use: Do not hide or rename Sponsored, blend it into organic ranking, or accept ad payloads as commerce facts.
components.accessibility: Sponsored disclosure is visible and exposed in semantics; facts and actions retain the organic card contract.

components.usage: Use to explain the active service without creating a mini-brand or hiding the domain priority.
components.do_not_use: Do not add paid content to active emergency or transaction service identity.
components.accessibility: Service title, icon alternative, priority state, and any recovery action are explicit and not color-only.

components.usage: Use for package, courier, and roadside provider comparison when response data is available.
components.do_not_use: Do not rank or highlight a carrier using sponsored, campaign, merchant, or arbitrary UI data.
components.accessibility: Provider, capability, ETA, price, availability, and selected state are visible and semantically announced.
